svg.title: ASSURED: from learning to genome-editing evidence
svg.desc: Academy offers 12 lessons. Bench combines design, reagent planning, Sanger trace analysis and clone results. The APOE R176C practice benchmark uses simulated AB1 traces. Actual app-generated guide, edit and silent-blocking annotations are shown. Homozygous example: intended edit 96 percent, accept. Heterozygous example: intended edit 48.2 percent, hold. Partial-conversion example: intended edit 49.7 percent, hold.

g.text: Orange: silent changes · Purple: intended edit
Select clones · compare edits and support
